void-canvas.$description: Void Canvas — Primary page background, base surface for the dark UI shell

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated surface for floating panels, pill nav bar, modal bodies — one step above canvas

frosted-glass.$description: Frosted Glass — Translucent panel fill at 10% opacity over dark surfaces — creates the frosted overlay look on the floating nav and feature cards

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Icon strokes, SVG fill, deep contrast elements on light surfaces

snow-white.$description: Snow White — Primary CTA fill, headline text on dark surfaces, card backgrounds — the inverted counterweight to the dark canvas

bone.$description: Bone — Primary readable text on dark surfaces — slightly warmer than pure white, reduces glare

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary body text, helper copy, de-emphasized labels

slate.$description: Slate — Muted text, link text, tertiary metadata, timestamp-style labels

smoke.$description: Smoke — Disabled or idle button text, integration label text in ghost controls

hairline.$description: Hairline — 1px borders on dark-surface controls — appears as a light edge against the dark canvas, creating definition without weight

dusk-violet.$description: Dusk Violet — The only chromatic accent — used at 0.565 alpha in a horizontal gradient wash to add a single pulse of color to the dark UI; Radial glow accent — concentrated violet center fading to white, used as spotlight or product reveal moment

dm-sans.$description: Primary display and body face — used for the 72px hero headline (weight 500, -0.035em tracking) and all 16px body/UI text. The weight-500 display choice is anti-convention: most sites push 700+ for hero headlines, but DM Sans at 500 with tight tracking achieves authority through restraint and modernity through geometric clarity.

geist.$description: Secondary face for feature headings and editorial body — Geist's mono-adjacent precision adds a technical, product-aware texture to section headings (32px/600, 36px/500, 48px/500). The 24px body usage in Geist creates a slightly more compressed, information-dense reading rhythm compared to DM Sans.

system-ui.$description: system-ui — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
